_howto: Access Control tours. The menu (#acMenu) and screens (#acContent) are drawn by access_control.js; a screen is open when its menu link has class active.
title: Access Control tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Access Control
steps.text:
Decide who may open which door, and when. The controllers get the changes within about a minute, and you can see who is inside at any time.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All screens
steps.text: You only see the screens your role allows. Set up in this order: Time Zones, Doors & Readers, Access Levels, Assignments, then Schedule Rules.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.text: Doors, controllers and live events right now, with the emergency release button.

steps.title: Doors & Readers
steps.text: Each controller and the doors on it: name, direction, how long it unlocks, and exit rules.

steps.title: Time Zones
steps.text: Weekly timetables: when a door or access level is usable.

steps.title: Holidays
steps.text: The public holidays from Time & Attendance; on these days each time zone's holiday row applies.

steps.title: Access Levels
steps.text: A set of doors plus a time zone. People are given levels.

steps.title: Assignments
steps.text: Who gets which access levels: per level, per person, or for a whole department.

steps.title: Schedule Rules
steps.text: How access follows the roster: how early people may enter before their shift and how long after, and whether leave blocks access.

steps.title: Reports
steps.text: Who came and went, and who can open which door.

steps.title: Zones & Who's Inside
steps.text: Split the site into zones and see who is inside each one: your muster list in an evacuation.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Type what you're looking for, like doors or muster, to jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Your profile, other areas of the system, Help & Tours, Demo / Setup mode, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, and how-to guides such as setting up a door or giving people access.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Right now
steps.text: Doors, controllers online and today's events. It refreshes every few seconds while you watch.

steps.title: Each door
steps.text: Whether each door is open or closed (if it has a sensor) and its controller's state.

steps.title: Live events
steps.text: Every card swipe, face or fingerprint, granted or refused, as it happens.

steps.title: Emergency release
steps.text: Opens every emergency-route door at once, for example in a fire. Ending it returns the doors to normal.

steps.title: Add a door
steps.text: Each controller shows here. Add a door for each lock it drives, up to four per controller.

steps.title: Send to the controller
steps.text: Changes go to the controllers by themselves within about a minute. Use this to resend everything, for example after a controller was replaced.

steps.title: Add a time zone
steps.text: Up to three open periods per day, plus rows for holidays. 24 Hours is always there.

steps.title: Add an access level
steps.text: A name, the doors, the time zone, and whether it only works when the person is scheduled to work.

steps.title: Three ways
steps.text: By level: add people to a level. By person: all of one person's levels, dates and special settings. By department: everyone in a department, including new starters, gets its levels.

steps.title: Follow the roster
steps.text: For levels marked Only when scheduled: people get in from a number of minutes before their shift until a number of minutes after it.

steps.title: Before and after
steps.text: How early they may come in and how long they may stay. Individual shifts can have their own minutes.

steps.title: Leave
steps.text: Whether being on approved leave blocks access.

steps.title: Try it
steps.text: Pick a person to see exactly when they could get in over the next days.

steps.title: Events and door access
steps.text: Events: who came and went, filtered by door, person and dates. The other tabs show who can open which door. Everything exports to Excel.

steps.title: Inside now, and setup
steps.text: See who is in each zone now (print or export it as a muster list), and set up zones and which door leads from which zone to which.
